cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo mosaic ~6-kb LINE-1 insertion in CYBB intron 3 causes abnormal splicing with pseudoexon inclusion and a premature stop codon; phagocytes are almost all mutant. Whether the pseudoexon is L1-derived is not stated in the abstract.
cases.quote: Sanger sequencing detected a 6-kb insertion of a LINE-1 transposable element in the third intron of CYBB, leading to abnormal splicing and pseudoexon insertion
